BUG-001.title: Analyte dispatch hardcoded to phosphate
BUG-001.description: executeLISAPipeline resolved analyte via hardcoded index 0. Selecting Iron, Fluoride, Nitrate, or Lead still executed the phosphate model.
BUG-001.fix: Accept analyteId in PipelineExecutionOptions, validate against supported calibration models. Unsupported analytes immediately halt with status UNSUPPORTED_ANALYTE, isRejected: true, concentration: null, uncertainty: null, selectedModel: 'none'.

BUG-002.title: Device normalization is dead code
BUG-002.description: normalizeDeviceSpectrum existed in deviceCalibration.ts but was never invoked in executeLISAPipeline. Device calibration profiles had no mathematical effect.
BUG-002.fix: Integrated normalizeDeviceSpectrum into the orchestrator pipeline prior to optical cross-correlation alignment. Calibrated devices now mathematically scale raw spectra by inverse spectral sensitivity.

BUG-003.title: Ridge CV has replicate/group leakage
BUG-003.description: Sample-level LOOCV on 21 standards (7 concentrations x 3 replicates) held out 1 replicate while leaving 2 identical concentrations in training, leaking ground-truth signal.
BUG-003.fix: Implemented Leave-One-Concentration-Out cross-validation. In each of 7 folds, all 3 replicates of a concentration are held out. Grouped CV RMSE recomputed genuinely as 0.0481 mg/L (MAE: 0.0261 mg/L, R2: 0.9807).

BUG-004.title: Uncertainty ignores sample-specific noise
BUG-004.description: Uncertainty was fixed to max(0.015, loocvRmse), giving noisy and pristine samples identical confidence intervals.
BUG-004.fix: Implemented computeSampleSpectralResidual calculating sample-specific residual variance s_res^2 = sum((A_meas - A_recon)^2) / df and added sample variance in quadrature with CV error in concentration space.

BUG-005.title: Hard-coded scientific fallback metrics
BUG-005.description: Failure paths in wavelength.ts and beerLambert.ts returned hardcoded prototype metrics (R2=0.9995, R2=0.99, RMSE=0.02, LOD=0.05).
BUG-005.fix: Removed all fabricated fallbacks. Insufficient standards or references (< 2 points) return isValid: false, explicit error codes, and r2: null, rmse: null, lod: null, loq: null.

BUG-006.title: Live camera capture falls back to simulator
BUG-006.description: Camera started MediaStream, but clicking Capture ran simulateSpectrum instead of extracting the video frame.
BUG-006.fix: Implemented CameraAdapter.captureFrame and extractSpectrumFromVideo to draw HTMLVideoElement to offscreen canvas, detect ROI, and bin spatial transmission profile. Wired into AcquisitionPanel. Refuses simulator fallback in LIVE CAMERA mode.

BUG-007.title: Beer-Lambert / Ridge model comparison unit mismatch
BUG-007.description: Beer-Lambert calibration fit RMSE was measured in Absorbance Units (AU) but presented as mg/L, creating a dimensional mismatch against Ridge RMSE (mg/L).
BUG-007.fix: Enforced dimensional consistency: Beer-Lambert calibration fit error is explicitly AU (rmseUnit: 'AU'); converted concentration-space prediction error is mg/L (concentrationRmse = rmse / slope); Ridge CV error is mg/L. ModelComparison updated accordingly.

BUG-009.title: History does not persist
BUG-009.description: History records were stored in React state only and lost upon page refresh.
BUG-009.fix: Implemented historyStorage.ts using versioned localStorage key 'lisa.history.v1' with JSON corruption recovery and 50-record capping. Initialized on mount and synced in App.tsx.

BUG-010.title: ROI detector uses maximum variance row rather than centroid
BUG-010.description: Single max-variance row latched onto high-contrast cuvette edges rather than the dispersed spectral band center.
BUG-010.fix: Replaced single max-variance row selection with computeVarianceCentroid: weighted center-of-mass of the top 20% variance rows.

BUG-011.title: Hard-coded diagnostics execution time
BUG-011.description: DiagnosticsModal displayed static '18.4 ms' before any pipeline run had occurred.
BUG-011.fix: Replaced static metric with '—' when lastExecutionMs === 0, and measured latency after runs.

BUG-012.title: Mobile header overflow
BUG-012.description: Header toolbar buttons overflowed viewports narrower than 768px.
BUG-012.fix: Coordinated with UI architecture: Header consolidated secondary actions into an accessible overflow menu dropdown, eliminating horizontal toolbar overflow.

BENCHMARK-HONESTY.title: Simulated vs wet-lab benchmark labeling ambiguity
BENCHMARK-HONESTY.description: Benchtop concordance table in labBenchmark.ts could be mistaken for physical wet-lab trials.
BENCHMARK-HONESTY.fix: Tagged all rows with provenance: 'SIMULATED'. Clarified headers and UI copy to 'Simulated reference standards'.
